psychological_meaning: Kaitoke Green evokes feelings of tranquility, growth, and connection to nature. It symbolizes harmony, balance, and renewal, often associated with environmental awareness and sustainability. This color promotes a sense of calm and encourages a focus on well-being and natural beauty. Its grounding nature inspires stability and resilience.
